axis: Z up; X across rack; Y rack depth; FBX -Y forward

cargo_modeling_rules.stack_contact: Cartons rest on each other; the bevel creates a visible layer seam without floating boxes.
cargo_modeling_rules.B: One layer of 0.36 or 0.38 m cartons per pallet in the narrow CAD shelf interval.
cargo_modeling_rules.A_D1: Four 0.40 or 0.42 m carton layers, with every fourth pallet having three layers.
cargo_modeling_rules.C_D2: Three 0.38 or 0.40 m carton layers per pallet.
cargo_modeling_rules.top_clearance: Do not fill the CAD envelope. Verify every stack is below the next beam bottom (or upright top for the uppermost level).
cargo_modeling_rules.pallet_dimensions: Original CAD 1.016 x 1.2192 x 0.123952 m; separate runners, blocks and boards preserve fork openings.
